screen.look: Send a screenshot to the AI

auto.read: Read the page in KIVO’s browser

uia.find: Look for controls in a window
uia.get_tree: Read the controls of a window
uia.invoke: Press a button in an app
uia.toggle: Switch an option on or off
uia.select: Select an item in an app

files.delete: Move files to the Recycle Bin

reply.shuttingDown: Shutting down in a few seconds.

audio.output: KIVO now speaks on {name}. Pick it for everything else in the list that opened.

recycled.one: Moved {count} item to the Recycle Bin.
recycled.other: Moved {count} items to the Recycle Bin.

shell.timedOut: The command took too long, so I stopped it.

system.charging: The battery is at {percent}% and charging.

uia.customDrawn: This app draws its own controls, so I can only see it as a picture.

error.unsupported: That isn’t supported on this PC.
error.elevated: {name} is running as administrator, so Windows won’t let KIVO control it. KIVO never makes itself administrator.

missing.window: I didn’t get a window to use.
missing.title: I didn’t get a title.
missing.query: I didn’t get what to search for.
missing.region: I didn’t get which part of the screen.

error.timeout: That took too long, so I stopped waiting.

hint.notFound: {message} Try saying the name a different way.
hint.accessDenied: {message} You may need to allow it in Windows.

error.stillOpen: {name} is still open. It may be asking you to save something.

browser.noExtension: KIVO’s browser extension isn’t connected. Install it from Settings → Integrations to read and act on pages.
browser.notInFront: A browser isn’t the window in front.
browser.noElement: I couldn’t find that on the page.
browser.notAWebPage: That tab isn’t a web page.
browser.tooLarge: The page sent too much at once.

clipboard.readOff: Reading the clipboard is turned off.
clipboard.writeOff: Writing to the clipboard is turned off.

files.network: KIVO only works with files on this PC, not network or device paths.
files.relative: I need the full path of the file.
files.traversal: That path steps outside its folder, so I won’t use it.
files.stream: That path isn’t a plain file name.
files.badName: A new name can’t contain slashes or colons.
files.outside: That’s outside the folders KIVO may use.
files.private: That folder is private, so KIVO won’t touch it.

input.moved: The window moved or changed, so I didn’t click.
input.notInFront: That window isn’t in front anymore, so I stopped.
input.outside: That point is outside the window.

router.noWay: I couldn’t find a way to do that with “{target}”.
router.uriRefused: KIVO only opens links for apps it knows.

screen.noOcr: Text recognition isn’t available: add a language with OCR in Windows Settings → Language.
screen.visionOff: Sending screenshots to an AI is off. KIVO can still read the screen locally.

uia.password: That’s a password field. KIVO never types into those.

system.noBrightness: This screen’s brightness can’t be changed from Windows.

shell.readOnly: Only read-only commands are allowed. Change this in Permissions → Capabilities → Shell.

policy.stopped: Stopped. KIVO won’t continue this request.
policy.blockedApp: KIVO isn’t allowed to act on {name}.
policy.untrustedDestination: {address} came from content KIVO read, not from you, so it won’t send anything there.
policy.guestDenied: Only the owner can ask KIVO to do that.
policy.highTainted: This can’t be undone, and it was requested by the AI or after reading other content.
policy.aiAsked: The AI asked for this, not you directly.
policy.askMode: You asked KIVO to check with you before doing things.
policy.acceptEditsMode: In Accept edits, KIVO checks before commands and settings.
policy.planMode: In Plan first, nothing changes until you approve the plan.
policy.differentAction: That approval was for a different action.
policy.voiceNotEnough: For this one, please click Allow or confirm with Windows Hello.
policy.notAWay: That isn’t a way to approve an action.
policy.privacyLocal: Your privacy setting keeps this on your PC.
policy.privacyCloudOff: Cloud AI is off, so this stays on your PC.
policy.privateData: Strict Private keeps personal data on this PC, so KIVO won’t send it.

turn.downloading: I’m still downloading my speech model ({percent}%).
turn.sttMissing: My speech recognition isn’t installed yet. Open Voice settings to get it.
turn.handsFreeFailed: Hands-free listening couldn’t start. Push-to-talk still works; check the wake-word model on the Voice page.
turn.sttSlow: My speech engine didn’t start in time. Try again.
turn.nothingWaiting: There’s nothing waiting for an answer.
turn.ttsLost: I lost my voice engine for a moment. Try again.
turn.micBlocked: I can’t reach the microphone. Check Windows privacy settings.
turn.bypassNeedsStep: Bypass permissions needs its confirmation step, which isn’t available yet
turn.unknownModel: KIVO doesn’t know a model called {id}

firstClose.title: KIVO is still running
firstClose.body: Closing the window keeps KIVO in the tray, ready when you call. Quit it from the tray.

mic.title: KIVO can’t use the microphone
mic.body: Windows is blocking it. You can allow it in Settings, or type to KIVO instead.

crash.title: KIVO stopped unexpectedly last time
crash.body: A crash report was saved on this PC. It isn’t sent anywhere.

refuse.pause: KIVO can pause only while it isn’t busy ({state})
refuse.listen: KIVO can listen only when it isn’t busy or paused ({state})

preview.busy: KIVO is busy with a request. Try the preview again when it's done.

voiceId.needMore: Record at least {count} of the prompts first.
voiceId.modelMissing: The voice-recognition model is still downloading. Try again when it's ready.
voiceId.notHeard: KIVO didn't hear anything. Try again a little closer to the microphone.
voiceId.busy: KIVO is listening for a request right now. Try again in a moment.

wake.noModel: The wake-word listener isn't downloaded yet.
wake.unknown: There's no wake word with that name.

decision.guest: Only the owner can approve this. Tap Approve on the card if it's you.
decision.click: This one needs a click to approve. Tap Approve on the card.
decision.notOwner: I didn't recognize your voice, so I can't approve this by voice. Tap Approve on the card.
decision.editLater: I can't change the request by voice yet. Say allow, deny, or wait.
decision.sayAgain: Sorry, say allow, deny, or wait.
decision.noHello: Windows Hello isn’t set up on this PC, so please click Allow.
decision.helloFailed: Windows Hello didn’t confirm it, so KIVO won’t do it.

voice.removeActive: KIVO listens with this model and no other can take over. Download another one first, or confirm removing it.
voice.fallbackTts: {from} stopped working, so KIVO is using the Windows voices for now. Your choice is kept.
voice.fallbackStt: {from} stopped working, so KIVO is listening with {to} for now. Your choice is kept.
voice.fallbackNone: {from} couldn’t start, so KIVO can’t hear you. Open Voice to try again or pick another recognizer.
voice.incompatibleNone: {engine} doesn’t understand {language}, and KIVO has no engine for it yet.
voice.notAllowed: Your privacy setting keeps speech on this PC, so KIVO can’t use {engine}.
voice.unknownEngine: KIVO doesn’t know a speech engine called {id}.
voice.downloadFailed: The download didn’t finish. Check the connection and try again.
voice.loadFailed: It didn’t start on this PC: {error}
voice.testFailed: It started, but the test didn’t pass: {error}
voice.preview: Hi, I’m KIVO. How can I help?
voice.noHardware: KIVO couldn’t read this PC’s hardware, so it can’t recommend engines right now.
voice.notDownloaded: Download it first; then you can try it.
voice.notAnEngine: That model isn’t a speech engine KIVO can use for this language.

brain.noBrain: No AI brain is connected yet. You can connect one on the Brains page; some are free.
brain.needsLocal: That needs a brain on this PC, and none is running, so I didn’t send it anywhere.
brain.notConnected: {name} isn’t connected. You can add it on the Brains page.
brain.unavailable: {name} isn’t available right now. Try again in a moment.
brain.auth: {name} refused the sign-in. Check it on the Brains page.
brain.busy: {name} is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
brain.quota: {name} says the account is out of credit.
brain.network: I can’t reach {name}. Check the internet connection.
brain.tooManySteps: I stopped after several steps. Ask again if you want me to carry on.
brain.limitReached: You’ve reached your {period} spending limit of {amount}.
brain.limitAsk: Go over your {period} spending limit of {amount}
brain.limitWhy: You set a limit, and this request would go over it.
brain.limitBlocked: You’ve reached your {period} spending limit, so I didn’t send this.
brain.summarize: Summarize this conversation so far for your own later reference, in under 200 words. Keep facts, names, decisions, preferences and open questions; drop small talk. Write plain sentences.
brain.agentWhy: {name} asked for permission to do this.
brain.agentSignIn: {name} needs you to sign in first. Open the Brains page to sign in.
brain.toolNotOffered: That tool isn’t available for this request.

risk.writes: It can change files or settings.
risk.subexpression: It runs other commands inside it.
risk.system: It changes the system (registry, services, disks or users).
risk.elevationOrRemoteCode: It runs downloaded code or asks for administrator rights.
risk.unreadable: KIVO can’t read what it does.
